import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    if n % 2 == 1:
        print(0)
        return
    mp = {}
    ec = 0
    oc = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            ec += 1
        else:
            oc += 1
        if ec > 0 and oc > 0 and ec == oc:
            if i + 1 < n:
                mp[i] = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1])
    if not mp:
        print(0)
        return
    elif len(mp) == 1:
        cost = next(iter(mp.values()))
        print(1 if cost <= b else 0)
        return
    else:
        k = 0
        for key in sorted(mp):
            cost = mp[key]
            if cost <= b:
                b -= cost
                k += 1
            else:
                break
        print(k)
        return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
